newsitem.title: USA: Penske says N.C. Speedway likes offer.
newsitem.headline: Penske says N.C. Speedway likes offer.

text.p: Penske Motorsports Inc, which owns about 70 percent of North Carolina Motor Speedway Inc, said on Monday that a special committee of the speedway board has decided that Penske's offer to its minority shareholders is fair.

Penske issued a news release saying the committee also determined that the offer is well above the range of the value of the speedway as determined by the independent financial advisor engaged by the committee.

While the committee recommended first submitting to speedway shareholders the proposal of Speedway Motorsports Inc to buy the speedway, the committee acknowledged that the board could in good faith submit only the Penske offer to shareholders, the news release said.

While Penske's Speedway Motorsports' offers are both fair, Penske's ownership of 70 percent of the speedway's stock would make submission of the other offer "futile," the news release said the committee had found.

Penske said it will submit a copy of the committee report to all Speedway shareholders for their consideration and adjourned today's annual meeting of Speedway shareholders to July 22 in order to give minority shareholders an opportunity to hear an explanation of both offers.
The speedway is a one-mile oval track located in Rockingham, North Carolina.
